findings.evidence: TauCeti/Analysis/Calculus/ContDiff/Bounds.lean:141 `theorem ContDiffOn.exists_nonneg_bound_iteratedFDeriv_of_isOpen {u : E → F} {s K : Set E} {n : ℕ} (hu : ContDiffOn 𝕜 n u s) (hs : IsOpen s) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKs : K ⊆ s) : ∃ A, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ i ≤ n, ∀ z ∈ K, ‖iteratedFDeriv 𝕜 i u z‖ ≤ A`
findings.fix: Delete it. At `HigherOrderEstimate.lean:290` and `:391`, use `hZ.exists_nonneg_bound_iteratedFDeriv_of_isOpen hO hUc hUO` and its analogue, then turn the bound into an `ℝ≥0` with `⟨A, hA0⟩` (or `Real.toNNReal`).
findings.issue: `_root_.IsCompact.exists_bound_iteratedFDeriv` is new, public, in the root namespace and stated only for `Set ℂ` over ℝ. It is a special case of main's `ContDiffOn.exists_nonneg_bound_iteratedFDeriv_of_isOpen`, which works for any normed space `E` over any `𝕜`, and the PR re-proves it.

findings.evidence: Sobolev/Basic.lean:269-275 sets the variables `{E} [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] ... (μ : Measure E) [μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]`, and `lowerOrderL` (line 594) is defined there; the PR's lemma uses `C.lowerOrderL volume p k`.
findings.fix: State it for general `C : SectionChartData E F S` and `μ`, as `‖C.lowerOrderL μ p k w‖ ≤ ‖w‖`, and place it next to `lowerOrderL_apply` / `norm_component_le` in `Sobolev/Basic.lean`.
findings.issue: `SectionChartData.norm_lowerOrderL_le` is public but fixed to `SectionChartData ℂ F S` with `volume`. Its proof uses only `lowerOrderL_apply`, `Wkp.norm_lowerOrder_le` and the sup norm, so it holds for the setting where main defines `lowerOrderL`: any finite-dimensional inner-product `E` and any `μ` with `[μ.IsAddHaarMeasure]`.

summary: Two new public helpers are stated only for ℂ with volume, though each holds in the generality the existing code already uses; one repeats a general lemma already on main. The Sobolev-norm and Cauchy–Riemann statements themselves sit at the right level.
